summary:
Close the final public AlembicPlugin retrieval acceptance after the accepted Core repair.

Accepted upstream:
- AlembicCore exact commit 10e43a66fac8748b1da176844bd77505aa949b0e; its parent 0fff37dbbb8bd311bc99b455bbc9a22431b063bb is the accepted bounded stability-refill repair, and 10e43a66 adds canonical sparse role corroboration without query/data hardcoding.
- AlembicPlugin baseline bdcb3de1d6aa35732a141cbd699b4007b6bbafa6 already contains the accepted Prime public-output bound/fallback fix.
- Controller independently reran Core focused tests 81/81, full tests 1751/1751, boundary 22/22, build/lint/diff/hardcode checks; copy-only BiliDili Core matrix ranks [1,1,1,1,1,1,2,2] with raw dense/sparse/RRF and protected roots unchanged.
- Controller independently ran the three frozen AlembicWorkspace control queries through the currently loaded public Search MCP; all expected Recipes were rank 1 with vector evidence.

This package is an integration/acceptance closure, not permission to redesign ranking:
1. Rebuild AlembicPlugin from the exact local Core commit 10e43a66 and verify runtime provenance resolves @alembic/core to the sibling Core source/dist, not a stale vendor or registry copy.
2. Start a fresh temporary Plugin MCP process from the rebuilt dist. Do not use the already loaded host process as the only evidence.
3. Against the real BiliDili knowledge base in request-scoped read-only mode, run the frozen eight queries serially through both public Search and Prime at the same limit (8), for three warm repetitions plus the fresh-process run. Require every call ok, exact ordered candidate-ID parity between Search and Prime, every target Top3, no regression from the accepted Core matrix, raw dense/sparse/RRF evidence present, no sparse-only transient degradation, and Prime/public schema bounds preserved.
4. Against AlembicWorkspace, run the frozen three control semantics (canonical Recipe production entry/validation pipeline; Markdown→SQLite→vector truth flow; knowledge:changed keyword/vector propagation) through public Search and Prime. Require expected Recipes Top3, ordered parity, and vector evidence.
5. Fingerprint all protected real DB/WAL/SHM/config/vector/Recipe roots before and after; changed set must be empty. No rescan, rebuild, re-embed, migration, generation activation, maintenance, publish, or query-time write.
6. Run focused public-tool/retrieval tests plus repository build/check/lint/boundary/plugin smoke/distribution/session gates appropriate to the touched surface.
7. If exact-Core rebuild and fresh-process acceptance pass with no Plugin source defect, return completed with an explicit no-commit reason and clean baseline. If a genuine Plugin integration defect is reproduced, fix only AlembicPlugin, add RED/GREEN evidence, and make one clean commit with exact parent bdcb3de1d6aa35732a141cbd699b4007b6bbafa6.
8. Do not change Core/Alembic/Agent/Dashboard/Wakeflow/vendor/real knowledge data; do not add query text, UUID, title, synonym, provider, host-project, Git-state, visibility/status, or data-availability gates; do not create or use a Test window.
designIntent: Consume the accepted Core retrieval behavior through the existing Plugin adapter and prove the public Search/Prime contract in a fresh process; change Plugin only if a reproducible Plugin-owned defect remains.

required.verify: fresh Plugin MCP process resolves the exact accepted sibling AlembicCore commit 10e43a66fac8748b1da176844bd77505aa949b0e
BiliDili frozen eight-query Search/Prime matrix across fresh plus three serial warm repetitions; exact ordered parity, all targets Top3, raw lanes/RRF, no degradation
AlembicWorkspace three frozen control semantics through Search and Prime; expected Recipes Top3 with ordered parity and vector evidence
protected real DB/WAL/SHM/config/vector/Recipe fingerprints identical before and after
focused retrieval/public-tool plus build/check/lint/boundary/plugin smoke/distribution/session gates
one clean AlembicPlugin commit with exact parent bdcb3de when a Plugin defect is fixed, otherwise explicit verified no-commit reason and clean baseline

targetTasks.summary: Rebuild Plugin against accepted Core 10e43a66 and close fresh-process BiliDili/AlembicWorkspace public Search-Prime parity, Top3, schema-bound and zero-write acceptance.
